items.headline: One of the great collapses — Celtic blow a 4-0 aggregate lead and lose 5-1 at LASK
items.body: Six days after cruising to a 3-0 first-leg win, Celtic authored one of the worst nights in their European history. Callum McGregor even pushed it to 4-0 on aggregate early in Austria — then it all fell apart. LASK scored four to force extra time, Samuel Adeniran bagged a hat-trick, and the Austrians won 5-1 on the night (5-4 on aggregate) to reach the Champions League league phase for the first time ever. Celtic drop into the Europa League.
items.say: Did you see Celtic somehow lost after being up 4-0 on aggregate? They got beat 5-1 in the second leg — total meltdown. That's the stuff that haunts a fanbase for years. You follow European soccer at all?

items.headline: Football's back Saturday — and Belichick's North Carolina opens the season in Ireland
items.body: College football kicks off Week 0 this Saturday, and the headliner is a good one: Bill Belichick's North Carolina faces TCU in Dublin (noon ET, ESPN) — UNC's first-ever game outside the U.S. It's a rematch of TCU's 48-14 rout in Belichick's debut last year, so the six-time Super Bowl winner is out to show his college project has come a long way. The full season really cranks up over Labor Day weekend.
items.say: College football's back Saturday — and Belichick's North Carolina is opening the season in Ireland of all places. Wild seeing him coach college. You got a team you pull for in the fall?

items.headline: The last Slam of the year starts Sunday — and world No. 1 Sinner is out
items.body: The US Open main draw begins Sunday in New York, and there's a huge hole at the top: world No. 1 Jannik Sinner has withdrawn with a right knee injury, his first missed major. That clears the path for Carlos Alcaraz, back from a wrist issue, to defend the title he won over Sinner in last year's final. With both stars having traded injuries all summer, fans will go a full year without seeing tennis's two best meet at a Slam.
items.say: The US Open starts this weekend and the No. 1 guy, Sinner, just pulled out hurt — so it's Alcaraz's tournament to lose. You ever get into the tennis majors?

items.headline: Extra-innings hero — Jarren Duran's 11th-inning grand slam keeps the Red Sox rolling
items.body: After going 0-for-4 with two strikeouts, Jarren Duran picked the perfect moment to break out: a one-out, 412-foot, 105-mph grand slam in the 11th inning to break a 3-3 tie and sink the Marlins 7-3. It was the second slam of his career and capped a stressful night that pushed Boston to its fifth straight win — nine of their last twelve — right in the thick of a September playoff push.
items.say: A Red Sox guy was having a brutal night at the plate, then hit a walk-it-open grand slam in the 11th inning. Baseball's funny like that. You catch much this time of year?

items.headline: Pogačar goes nuclear — a 50km solo raid in Andorra all but wins the Vuelta already
items.body: It's only Stage 4, but Tadej Pogačar may have already ended the race. On a brutal mountain day in Andorra, he attacked with 50 kilometers to go, dropped everyone, and soloed to the line nearly three minutes clear of the chasers. The Spanish Grand Tour runs all the way to Sept. 13, but the superstar Slovenian already leads by minutes — the kind of ride that leaves rivals shaking their heads.
items.say: That cyclist Pogačar just attacked from 50 kilometers out and won a mountain stage of the Vuelta by like three minutes. Guy races like he's from another planet. You ever watch the big bike races?

items.headline: Ridley Scott goes post-apocalyptic — 'The Dog Stars' lands in theaters Friday
items.body: The legendary director of 'Alien' and 'Gladiator' is back with 'The Dog Stars,' opening Aug. 28. Jacob Elordi plays a pilot surviving in a collapsed world with only his dog and a gruff survivalist (Josh Brolin) for company — until a mysterious radio signal pulls him out to search for whatever's left of humanity. Margaret Qualley, Guy Pearce and Allison Janney round out a stacked cast.
items.say: There's a new Ridley Scott movie Friday — post-apocalyptic survival thing with Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin. Looks gorgeous and pretty bleak. You into that end-of-the-world genre?

items.headline: Rod Wave drops 'Don't Look Down' Friday — one of streaming's biggest stars returns
items.body: One of the most-streamed artists in the country is back: Rod Wave's seventh album, 'Don't Look Down,' arrives Aug. 28, with a headlining arena tour to follow this fall. Known for his melodic, heart-on-sleeve blend of rap and R&B, he's been teasing the record all year with singles like 'Hustle' and 'Feed the Streets.' Expect it to rocket up the charts the second it lands.
items.say: New Rod Wave album drops Friday — dude quietly moves more streams than almost anybody. Real emotional, melodic rap. You know his stuff?

items.headline: 'Reacher' is back — Season 4 is rolling out weekly on Prime Video
items.body: Alan Ritchson's mountain of a hero returns for Season 4, out now on Prime Video with new episodes weekly through mid-September. This run adapts Lee Child's 'Gone Tomorrow' — Reacher witnesses a shocking act on a New York City subway and gets sucked into a sprawling conspiracy. It's still one of streaming's most reliably fun action shows, and a spin-off ('Neagley') is already teed up to follow.
items.say: New season of Reacher is out — the big guy who solves everything with his fists and a toothbrush. Perfect no-homework TV. You watch that one?

items.headline: One of the world's biggest festivals is on — Reading & Leeds takes over the UK bank holiday
items.body: The legendary twin festival runs across the UK's August bank holiday weekend (Aug. 27-30) with an all-British-and-Irish headline bill for the first time in 25 years — Charli XCX, Florence + the Machine, Fontaines D.C., RAYE, Dave and Chase & Status up top. Charli's set is billed as her only UK festival show of the year, so it's the hot ticket of the weekend.
items.say: The big Reading and Leeds festival is going on this weekend — Charli XCX, Florence, Fontaines D.C. headlining. Peak end-of-summer festival energy. You ever done a proper music festival?
